name: 90-degree L-bracket (Regalwinkel) PETG
summary: Right-angle shelf bracket: vertical leg at the -X end (100 mm high, 30 mm wide, 5 mm thick) with a horizontal arm along the top (120 mm long, 30 mm wide, 5 mm thick), joined by a diagonal brace. Four Ø5.5 through-holes (two in the arm, axis Z; two in the leg, axis X). Overall envelope 120 x 30 x 100 mm, centred in X/Y, sitting on z=0.
orientation_note: X = length (left-right, 120 mm), Y = width (30 mm, +Y toward the front face), Z = height (100 mm, up). The vertical leg is at the -X end; the horizontal arm runs from the leg toward +X along the top. The diagonal brace runs from the leg (z=35) up to the underside of the arm (x=+15).

features.description: Upright leg at the -X end, full height.
features.position: x from -60 to -55, y from -15 to +15, z from 0 to 100

features.name: horizontal_arm
features.description: Top arm along the top edge of the leg, extending toward +X.
features.position: x from -60 to +60, y from -15 to +15, z from 95 to 100

features.name: diagonal_brace
features.description: Diagonal gusset connecting the leg to the arm underside, 10 mm wide in Y, 6 mm thick, centred in Y.
features.position: from (x=-55, z=35) on the leg to (x=+15, z=95) on the arm underside, y centred at 0

features.name: arm_holes
features.description: Two through-holes in the arm, axis Z, for shelf mounting.
features.position: x=-25, y=0 and x=+45, y=0 (z through the 5 mm arm)

features.name: leg_holes
features.description: Two through-holes in the vertical leg, axis X, for wall mounting.
features.position: z=15, y=0 and z=70, y=0 (x through the 5 mm leg)

construction_notes: The body is a simple L: a 5 mm-thick vertical plate (leg) standing at the -X end and a 5 mm-thick horizontal plate (arm) capping its top, both 30 mm wide in Y. A 10 mm-wide, 6 mm-thick diagonal brace is fused between the leg face (at z=35) and the arm underside (at x=+15), centred in Y, forming the triangular gusset seen in the reference photo. All four holes are clean through-holes; no fasteners are included.
